findings.what: PlatoMark icon in FitCard header is hardcoded to `colors.gray[700]` (#404040 — a very dark gray) with no dark mode variant. In dark mode this icon is essentially invisible against a dark card background.
findings.why_matters: The spec (dark mode section, lines 208-214) requires every icon color using specific gray scale values to use a `t.dark` ternary (e.g., `t.dark ? t.color.gray[400] : t.color.gray[700]`). The `PlatoMark` component receives `color` as a plain prop from the JSX call site (`<PlatoMark size={15} color={colors.gray[700]} />`), not via a styled component, so no theme access exists at this call site. The component has no `useTheme` import. `gray[700]` = #404040 renders as near-black which disappears on dark mode card surfaces.
findings.fix: Import `useTheme` from `@emotion/react`, call `const t = useTheme() as any` at the top of `PlatoTab`, then pass `color={t.dark ? t.color.gray[400] : t.color.gray[700]}` to the PlatoMark on line 182. This matches the icon color ternary pattern used in `AchievementIcon` (line 723: `color: ${t.dark ? t.color.gray[400] : t.color.gray[700]}`) elsewhere in this same file.
